title: Run-length Burrows–Wheeler transform

problem.name: Run-length Burrows–Wheeler transform
problem.statement_latex: Given a string $S\in\Sigma^n$ with a unique end marker, output the run-length encoding of its Burrows--Wheeler transform, containing $r$ runs. Complexity counts indexed character queries and time.
